**Coaching note:**
When your opponent's king lacks escape squares, forcing moves with your pieces can trap it. Look for checks that drive the king deeper into danger rather than letting it escape toward the center. Here, Na7+ and Nc6+ squeeze Black's king into the corner where it has no defense against the mate threat on a6.
